mapper.select: SELECT notice_id, role_snapshot, COUNT(*) AS delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_count FROM t_notice_recipient WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} GROUP BY notice_id, role_snapshot

SELECT notice_id, role_snapshot, COUNT(*) AS delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS read_count FROM t_notice_recipient WHERE notice_id IN #{id} GROUP BY notice_id, role_snapshot
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notice_recipient SET is_hidden = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND read_at IS NULL AND is_hidden = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO t_notice_recipient (notice_id, user_id, role_snapshot, farm_id, message_id, push_record_id, read_at, push_opened_at, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.noticeId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.roleSnapshot}, #{item.farmId}, #{item.messageId}, #{item.pushRecordId}, #{item.readAt}, #{item.pushOpenedAt}, #{item.isHidden}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notice_recipient r JOIN t_message m ON m.id = r.message_id LEFT JOIN t_push_record p ON p.id = r.push_record_id SET r.read_at = COALESCE(r.read_at, m.read_at), r.push_opened_at = COALESCE(r.push_opened_at, p.clicked_at), r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE r.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND (r.read_at IS NULL OR r.push_opened_at IS NULL)
